name: Master Proudfoot
subtitle: Distant Relative of Bilbo
game_text: <phase>Fellowship</phase>: If the twilight pool has fewer than 3 twilight tokens, add <twilight>2</twilight> to reveal the top 3 cards of your draw deck. Take all <culture>Shire</culture> cards revealed into hand and discard the rest.
flavor_text: “His name, of course, was Proudfoot, and well merited; his feet were large, exceptionally furry....”
